more_info.overview: Calcium peroxide is an inorganic peroxide used for flour or dough treatment. The US bread standard includes it in a specified group of dough-conditioning agents with a combined limit based on flour weight. JECFA identifies its flour-treatment function and notes its strong oxidising character. These processing conditions do not constitute a general daily-intake allowance.
more_info.banned_in:
Approved in the US.
US permission is limited to the uses and conditions in 21 CFR 136.110, checked in 2026.
No current country-wide food-use ban was confirmed in the regulatory sources checked in 2026.
The permissions checked in 2026 apply only to the specified preparations, food uses and conditions.
more_info.uses: Permitted in the US as a dough-conditioning ingredient in bread, rolls and buns under the specified limits.
